en.title: The Maldives signs four Bilateral MoUs with the Kingdom of Bahrain
en.description: The Maldives signs four Bilateral MoUs with the Kingdom of Bahrain
en.body:
The Maldives signs four Bilateral MoUs with the Kingdom of Bahrain

The Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Kingdom of Bahrain have concluded four bilateral Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) of cooperation, during the ongoing State Visit of President His Excellency Ibrahim Mohamed Solih to the Kingdom of Bahrain. The MoUs were signed during a special ceremony held at Qudaibiya Palace, in the presence of His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih and His Majesty King Hamad bin Isa Al-Khalifa.

On behalf of the Government of Maldives, Minister of Foreign Affairs His Excellency Abdulla Shahid signed the “Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Bahrain on Political Consultations” “Memorandum of understanding Between the government of the kingdom of Bahrain and the Government of the Republic of Maldives on Climate change” and the “Memorandum of Understanding for Cooperation between the Foreign Service Institute of Maldives of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives and the Mohammed Bin Mubarak Al Khalifa Academy for Diplomatic Studies of the Kingdom of Bahrain on Diplomatic Training and Exchange of Information and Documentation.”.

Minister of Youth and Sports His Excellency Ahmed Mahloof signed the ‘Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Republic of Maldives and the Government of the Kingdom of Bahrain on cooperation in the area of Youth and Sports Development’.

An MoU between the Government of the Republic Maldives, Bahrain Telecommunications Company B.S.C (Batelco.) and Dhivehi Raajjeyge Gulhun P.L.C (Dhiraagu), in the area of Cyber Security will also be signed during the visit. On behalf of the Government of Maldives, Minister of Finance His Excellency Ibrahim Ameer will sign the MoU.

In a joint Press Conference held by Minister Shahid and his counterpart, His Excellency Dr. Abdullatif bin Rashid Al-Zayani, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Bahrain this afternoon in Manama, Minister Shahid highlighted that the conclusion of the four MoUs demonstrates the shared commitment of the leaderships of the Maldives and Bahrain to further elevate the long-standing relationship between the two countries.

Minister Shahid also stressed the importance of on-going discussions on concluding a Visa Waiver Agreement between the Maldives and Bahrain, which once concluded will allow Maldivians to travel to Bahrain without obtaining a visa prior to travel. Minister Shahid highlighted that such an MoU, in addition to easier travel, will also facilitate commerce and increase people-to-people contact.

President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih is undertaking a State Visit to Bahrain at the invitation of the King of Bahrain, His Majesty King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa.

The Government of Maldives established diplomatic relations with the Kingdom of Bahrain on 24 March 1980.

en.title: FOSIM holds Distinguished Speaker Series with former NASA Astronaut Captain Heidemarie M. Stefanyshyn-Piper
en.description: FOSIM holds Distinguished Speaker Series with former NASA Astronaut Captain Heidemarie M. Stefanyshyn-Piper
en.body:
FOSIM holds Distinguished Speaker Series with former NASA Astronaut Captain Heidemarie M. Stefanyshyn-Piper

The Foreign Service Institute of Maldives (FOSIM) invited Captain Heidemarie M. Stefanyshyn-Piper, Former NASA Astronaut, to deliver a talk at FOSIM, as part of FOSIM’s Distinguished Speaker Series, held today at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

In Captain Heidemarie M. Stefanyshyn-Piper’s talk, she shared her remarkable experiences and inspirational journey as an astronaut, and gave an insight into the Maldives- US relationship.

Captain Heidemarie Stefanyshyn-Piper is a mission specialist veteran of two space flights, STS-115 Atlantis in 2006 and STS-126 Endeavour in 2008. Selected as a NASA astronaut candidate in April 1996, she reported to Johnson Space Center in August 1996. During her time as an astronaut, she logged over 27 days in space, including 33 hours and 42 minutes of EVA in five spacewalks. She is also a qualified and experienced salvage officer. She received her commission from the Navy in June 1985. She completed training at the Naval Diving and Salvage Training Center in Panama City, Florida as a Navy Basic Diving Officer and Salvage Officer. In September 1994, Captain Stefanyshyn-Piper reported to the Naval Sea Systems Command as Underwater Ship Husbandry Operations Officer for the Supervisor of Salvage and Diving. In that capacity, she advised fleet diving activities in the repair of naval vessels while waterborne. Captain Piper received her Bachelor of Science and Master of Science degrees in Mechanical Engineering from Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1984 and 1985. Captain Piper retired from NASA in 2009 and returned to the U.S. Navy. She is currently involved in supporting STEM student groups to encourage future space explorers.

FOSIM Distinguished Speaker series features notable figures both at home and abroad, and aims to create dialogue and debate on issues of strategic, and global importance among the staff of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Today’s session was attended by senior officials of the Ministry, Chargé d’Affaires of the U.S. Mission to Maldives Andrea Appell and senior officials of the Embassy of the United States of America.

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid has sent a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea, His Excellency Park Jin, on the occasion of the National Foundation Day of the Republic of Korea.

The Minister’s message reads as follows:

"It is my pleasure to extend warm felicitations and good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of the Republic of Korea, on the auspicious occasion of the National Foundation Day of the Republic of Korea.

Maldives and the Republic of Korea continue to enjoy close bonds of friendship founded on shared values, mutual understanding, and goodwill. As we commemorate the 55th anniversary of diplomatic relations this year, I look forward to working closely with your Excellency to further elevate our relations to newer, greater heights.

Let me extend my best wishes and prayers for your success, good health and well-being, and the continued progress and welfare of the people of the Republic of Korea. Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Foreign Secretary of India concludes Official Visit to Maldives
en.description: Foreign Secretary of India concludes Official Visit to Maldives
en.body:
Foreign Secretary of India concludes Official Visit to Maldives

The Foreign Secretary of India Vinay Mohan Kwatra departed Maldives this afternoon after concluding his Official Visit to the Maldives on the invitation of Foreign Secretary of Maldives, Ahmed Latheef.

During his visit, he called on His Excellency Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, President of the Republic of Maldives and His Excellency President Mohamed Nasheed, Speaker of the Parliament. The Indian Foreign Secretary also held discussions with Minister of Defence, Minister of Finance and Minister of Economic Development to further discuss ongoing collaborations between Maldives and India. The Foreign Secretary of India also met with his counterpart Foreign Secretary, Ahmed Latheef.

Following productive discussions, the exchange of agreement signed between the Government of Maldives and EXIM bank of India to extend USD 100 million Line of Credit for the purpose of facilitating the numerous ongoing infrastructure projects in the Maldives took place in a special ceremony held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. A sea vessel procured for the Maldives Correctional Service under the 106 Million Indian Grant Assistance scheme signed in March 2019, was also handed over at the ceremony. Additionally, at a ceremony held at the Ministry of Defence, Foreign Secretary of India handed over 24 utility vehicles to the Maldives National Defence Force.

During his visit, Foreign Secretary of India also visited the site of the ongoing Greater Malé Connectivity Project to witness its progress. Overall, the Foreign Secretary concluded a very productive and successful visit in which the dynamic and long-standing relationship between Maldives and India effectively grew stronger and closer.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Unity Day greetings to the Federal Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Federal Republic of Germany
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Unity Day greetings to the Federal Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Federal Republic of Germany
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Unity Day greetings to the Federal Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Federal Republic of Germany

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Annalena Baerbock, Federal Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Federal Republic of Germany, on the 32nd Anniversary of the German Unity Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“It gives me great pleasure to convey warm greetings and sincere good wishes of the Government and the people of Maldives, and those of my own, to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of the Federal Republic of Germany, on the joyous occasion of the 32nd Anniversary of German reunification.

Since the establishment of diplomatic relations, the Maldives and Germany have enjoyed close and cordial relations founded on mutual respect, understanding and good will. Germany remains an important bilateral partner of the Maldives, and we have continued to closely cooperate on a wide array of mutual interests ranging from trade, tourism, investment, environment, and climate change. I remain committed to working with Your Excellency in expanding the existing ties of friendship and cooperation between our two countries.

Please accept, Excellency, my best wishes for your good health and well-being, and for further progress of the people of the Federal Republic of Germany and the assurances of my highest considerations.”

en.title: The Maldives and India exchange agreement for USD 100 million Line of Credit
en.description: The Maldives and India exchange agreement for USD 100 million Line of Credit
en.body:
The Maldives and India exchange agreement for USD 100 million Line of Credit

An agreement was exchanged today, between the Government of Maldives and Government of India to extend USD 100 million Line of Credit. The agreement was exchanged by Minister of Finance, Ibrahim Ameer, on behalf of the Government of Maldives and General Manager of EXIM Bank of India, Nirmit Ved in a special ceremony at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs today.

The purpose of this agreement is to ease and facilitate the numerous ongoing key infrastructure projects in the Maldives. The agreement exchanged today is a testament to the unwavering support and commitment of the Government of India in improving the socioeconomic wellbeing and public welfare of Maldives.

en.title: Foreign Secretaries of Maldives and India hold official discussions
en.description: Foreign Secretaries of Maldives and India hold official discussions
en.body:
Foreign Secretaries of Maldives and India hold official discussions

The Foreign Secretary of the Maldives, Ahmed Latheef and the Foreign Secretary of India, Vinay Mohan Kwatra held official discussions today, at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. During the meeting, both Foreign Secretaries reflected on the long historic relationship between both countries, and expressed commitment to move forward with genuine momentum and renewed vigour.

During the official discussion, both Foreign Secretaries noted the successful economic cooperation and the progress of projects that is being implemented under Indian grant assistance and line of credit scheme. The discussions also included matters relating to development cooperation, human resource development, multilateral engagements and consular affairs. Foreign Secretary Latheef expressed gratitude to the Government of India for the constant support and commitment shown to the people, and the development of the Maldives.

Foreign Secretary Kwatra is on a three-day official visit to the Maldives, keeping with the renewed tradition of high-level exchanges between the two countries.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Indonesia
en.description: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Indonesia
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Indonesia

Minister of Foreign Affairs His Excellency Abdulla Shahid sent a message of condolence to Her Excellency Retno L.P. Marsudi, Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia, following the loss of lives at Kanjuruhan Stadium tragedy in Malang - East Java, Indonesia.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“I am deeply saddened to hear the news of the tragic loss of lives at the Kanjuruhan Stadium in Malang - East Java, Indonesia.

On behalf of the Government and the people of Maldives, I extend our profound sympathies to the Government and the people of Indonesia, especially to the families who lost their loved ones.

Our thoughts and prayers are with the victims, and all affected by the tragedy, and we wish for the quick recovery of the injured.”

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Secretary of State of the United States of America
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Secretary of State of the United States of America
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Secretary of State of the United States of America

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Secretary of State of the United States of America, Anthony J. Blinken, following the devastation caused by Hurricane Ian.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

I am deeply saddened to learn of the devastation caused by Hurricane Ian in different parts of the United States, including loss of lives, injury to many and extensive damage to property and infrastructure.

At this time of national distress, I extend our deepest sympathies and condolences to the Government and the people of the United States, especially to those from the affected States, and to the families who lost lives and livelihoods.

I hope that the efforts of the emergency response teams proceed with ease and commend the perseverance of the people of the United States during this time of national tragedy.

en.title: India hands over vessel to support Maldives Correctional Service
en.description: India hands over vessel to support Maldives Correctional Service
en.body:
India hands over vessel to support Maldives Correctional Service

Vessel procured with the financial support of the Indian Government was handed over to the Maldives Correctional Service in a ceremony held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs today. The symbolic token was received by Commissioner of Prisons Ahmed Mohamed Fulhu from the High Commissioner of India, Munu Mahawar.

The handover of the vessel marks the completion of this project under grant assistance scheme provided by the Government of India, which would be utilised to ease transportation issues and increase the capacity of Maldives Correctional Service to undertake its responsibilities in serving the community. The total amount allocated for this project was 8 million rufiyaa. The first component of this project concerned the procurement of land vehicles and the second component of this project, inaugurated today, entailed the construction of a sea vessel.

The financial support has been provided from the grant assistance of total 106 million rufiyaa granted to the Government of Maldives by the Government of India during the visit of the Minister of External Affairs of India in March 2019. The aim of the grant assistance is to conduct socio-economic development projects across the country which make a significant impact. The projects under this grant will be managed by local authorities.

en.title: Foreign Secretary of India arrives in Maldives on an Official Visit
en.description: Foreign Secretary of India arrives in Maldives on an Official Visit
en.body:
Foreign Secretary of India arrives in Maldives on an Official Visit

The Foreign Secretary of India Vinay Mohan Kwatra has arrived on an Official Visit to the Maldives this evening. The Foreign Secretary of India is visiting the Maldives on the invitation of the Foreign Secretary of Maldives, Ahmed Latheef.

Foreign Secretary Kwatra was received at Velana International Airport by Foreign Secretary of Maldives, Ahmed Latheef.

During this visit, the Foreign Secretaries of the Maldives and India will discuss ongoing collaborations between both Governments and review progress, on ongoing projects under Indian development assistance to Maldives.

The Foreign Secretary of India will also call on His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, Speaker of Parliament His Excellency President Mohamed Nasheed, and Minister of Finance, Minister of Economic Development and Minister of Defence during the visit. This is the Indian Foreign Secretary’s first visit to the Maldives, since assuming office in May 2022.

en.title: Foreign Secretary of India to make an Official Visit to the Maldives
en.description: Foreign Secretary of India to make an Official Visit to the Maldives
en.body:
Foreign Secretary of India to make an Official Visit to the Maldives

The Foreign Secretary of India, Vinay Mohan Kwatra will make an Official Visit to the Maldives, from 1 to 3 October 2022, on the invitation of the Foreign Secretary of Maldives, Ahmed Latheef.

During this visit, the Foreign Secretaries of the Maldives and India will discuss ongoing collaborations between both Governments and review progress, on ongoing projects under Indian development assistance to the Maldives.

The Foreign Secretary of India will also call on His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, Speaker of Parliament, His Excellency President Mohamed Nasheed, Minister of Defence, Minister of Finance, and Minister of Economic Development during this visit.
This is the Indian Foreign Secretary’s first visit to the Maldives, since assuming office in May 2022.
